audit.whatIsWrong: diff says EVEN but diffRating says 8.5/10 with a red tone and 'Hard matchup', against a 51.71% win rate over 907 games.
audit.why: The token and the number disagree with each other on the same page. The win rate supports EVEN.
audit.corrected: Left both alone rather than guess which is the intended scale; chart aligned to the packet. See questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Riven, Riven, Skill, Skill, Riven, Riven. The packet says Riven, then Illaoi for levels 2 through first item, then Riven at 2+ items.
audit.why: Every whys row already states the packet shape — level 1 to Riven, 'from Level 2 onward you take over', and the late game tilting back to her. Six of seven rows disagreed with their own text.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0] to Riven; phases[1,2,3,4,5] and win[1,2,3,4,5] to Illaoi as matched pairs, with the 4/10 ratings on rows 3 and 4 raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The shield was attributed to Broken Wings, and the Q3 was called a knockup.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Broken Wings (Q) is the three-cast dash chain, and the third hit knocks back. The shield is Valor (E), which also steps forward and blocks damage. Getting the slot wrong changes which cooldown the player waits out.
audit.corrected: Shield moved to Valor, knockup corrected to knockback, and the real cooldowns written in: Broken Wings 13s flat, Ki Burst 11s at rank 1, Valor 10s at rank 1, against your 4s Harsh Lesson.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks Ki Burst everywhere without a number, and never states the cooldown asymmetry that actually wins the lane.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson is 4s flat. Broken Wings is 13s flat and Ki Burst 11s at rank 1, so after her chain is spent you get several free W-resets before anything of hers comes back.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0].text as the trading rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Animation-cancel timings for Riven's combo are referenced but not specified.
audit.why: Riven's cancel windows are exactly the kind of mechanic the brief says is absent from Riot's text. I kept the advice at the level the data supports — fight in the gap after her chain, not during it.

edits.before: Riven's Level 1 Q chain and shield out-trade your unstacked, W-less kit.
edits.after: Riven's Level 1 Broken Wings chain and Valor shield out-trade your kit.

edits.before: Level 1 goes to Riven: her Q-dash chain and Broken Wings shield let her out-trade your single Tentacle before W is up, so play safe and last-hit under threat until you hit 2.
edits.after: Level 1 goes to Riven: Broken Wings (Q) dashes three times on one 13s cooldown and Valor (E) shields, so last-hit safely and hold your ground until Harsh Lesson is up at 2.

edits.before: Once W Harsh Lesson is online you punish the gap between her Q dashes: slam a Tentacle as she animation-cancels in, W-reset onto her, and she can't out-trade your slam DPS.
edits.after: Harsh Lesson is a 4s cooldown against a 13s Broken Wings and an 11s Ki Burst — once her chain is spent, W-reset onto her and slam. Fight in the gap, never into the opener.

edits.before: Bait her Q3 knockup, then W-reset in for a Tentacle slam
edits.after: Bait the Q3 knockback, then W-reset in for a Tentacle slam

edits.before: Save Third Strike knockup and R to dodge E and burst you late
edits.after: Save the Broken Wings knockback and R to dodge E and burst

notes: Riven's shield was attributed to Broken Wings in two places — it is Valor (E). 'Third Strike' is not an ability name, and the Q3 knocks back rather than up. The decisive cooldown asymmetry (4s Harsh Lesson versus a 13s Broken Wings chain) was never stated and is now the trading rule. Chart disagreed with the packet on six of seven rows. diff EVEN and diffRating 8.5/10 contradict each other on the page as shipped.
